edges.reason: claimNanas reads holderScores[msg.sender] to compute the user share.
claimNanas adds freshly harvested BANANA into globalClaimed.
claimNanas overwrites holderClaimed[msg.sender] with the new share.
claimNanas divides by globalScore to derive userShare.
claimNanas calls the KONGZ NFT contract to harvest rewards.
claimNanas reads balance and claimable values from BANANA.
syncScore accrues balance*interval into holderScores.
syncScore rewrites holderLastUpdate after accrual.
syncGlobalScore accrues totalSupply*interval into globalScore.
syncGlobalScore rewrites globalLastUpdate after accrual.
wrap pushes wrapped token ids into genIds.
unwrapFor swaps and pops entries from genIds.
wrap invokes KONGZ.safeTransferFrom to escrow NFTs.
unwrapFor invokes KONGZ.safeTransferFrom to release NFTs.
getClaimableNanas reads globalScore for share simulation.
getClaimableNanas reads holderLastUpdate to compute the interval.
getClaimableNanas reads globalClaimed as part of totalFarmed.
getClaimableNanas subtracts holderClaimed to obtain claimable amount.
getClaimableNanas queries BANANA.getTotalClaimable.
msg.sender is the recipient of the BANANA reward transfer.
claimNanas is keyed on msg.sender scores and balances.
wrap pulls NFTs from msg.sender and mints to msg.sender.
unwrap forwards msg.sender into unwrapFor.
unwrapFor burns msg.sender balances and seeds randomness with msg.sender.
transfer moves tokens from msg.sender via _msgSender().
transferFrom uses msg.sender for allowance checks and score sync.
getClaimableNanas can be queried for any caller-supplied holder.
_getSeed mixes block.timestamp into the pseudo-random seed, making selection miner-influenceable.
syncScore accrual depends on block.timestamp, allowing timestamp manipulation of scores.
syncGlobalScore accrual depends on block.timestamp.
getClaimableNanas derives claimable amounts straight from block.timestamp.
claimNanas performs the external BANANA.transfer before emitting and after partial accounting.
claimNanas calls KONGZ.getReward mid-function when the wrapper lacks enough BANANA.
wrap calls KONGZ.safeTransferFrom inside an unbounded loop.
unwrapFor calls KONGZ.safeTransferFrom loop before all state settles.
claimNanas consumes BANANA.getTotalClaimable(address(this)) as part of totalFarmed.
claimNanas performs userShare.sub(holderClaimed[msg.sender]) which reverts/underflows on inconsistent scores.
syncScore computes time.sub(lastUpdate) intervals feeding balance*interval multiplication.
syncGlobalScore computes time.sub(lastUpdate) feeding totalSupply*interval multiplication.
wrap computes _kongzIdsToWrap.length * 100 * 1e18 as mint amount.
unwrapFor computes _amount * 100 * 1e18 as burn amount.
BANANA.transfer hands control to msg.sender, which may re-enter claimNanas before holderClaimed is fully settled.
KONGZ.getReward is an external call that can re-enter the wrapper.
KONGZ.safeTransferFrom invokes receiver hooks that can re-enter wrap.
KONGZ.safeTransferFrom to an attacker recipient can re-enter unwrapFor.
safeTransferFrom to this contract triggers onERC721Received during wrap.
unwrap delegates execution to unwrapFor with msg.sender as recipient.
transfer executes under the syncScore(msg.sender,_to) modifier.
transferFrom executes under the syncScore(_from,_to) modifier.
claimNanas executes under syncScore(msg.sender,address(0)).
claimNanas executes under syncGlobalScore().
wrap executes under syncScore(msg.sender,address(0)).
wrap executes under syncGlobalScore().
unwrapFor executes under syncScore(msg.sender,address(0)).
unwrapFor executes under syncGlobalScore().
unwrapFor repeatedly calls _getSeed to pick tokens to release.
_kongzIdsToWrap drives the wrap loop and mint quantity.
_amount is forwarded from unwrap into unwrapFor.
_amount controls burn quantity and release loop count.
_recipient receives the released Kongz NFTs.
_to is the transfer destination and score-sync target.
_amount is the WGK quantity moved by transfer.
_from is the transferFrom source and score-sync account.
_to is the transferFrom destination and score-sync account.
_amount is the WGK quantity moved by transferFrom.
_holder selects which scores are simulated.
_from selects the holder whose score is accrued by the modifier.
_to selects the counterparty whose score is accrued by the modifier.
a is the first argument of min.
b is the second argument of min.
_seed selects the pseudo-random branch of _getSeed.
_sender is hashed into the pseudo-random seed when _seed is zero.
userShare is the minuend of the payout subtraction.
toSend is the value handed to BANANA.transfer.
_tokenId is the NFT id forwarded to KONGZ.safeTransferFrom.
